vo.text: Thirty-four dollars quietly disappears from your checking account every single month.
vo.bgPrompt: Dark minimalist glass office, stacks of cash on table lit by sharp spotlight

vo.text: Holding ten thousand in checking pays point zero one percent.
vo.bgPrompt: Macro shot of polished vault lock dial spinning slowly in low key lighting

vo.text: Your bank lends that cash overnight at five percent spread.
vo.bgPrompt: Cinematic dark skyscraper corridor with glowing blue server rack indicators

vo.text: Pause. How much cash are you holding right now?
vo.bgPrompt: Moody moody dark atmospheric shot of generic banking app on smartphone screen

vo.text: Comment your idle checking balance if you dare.
vo.bgPrompt: Extreme close-up on keyboard illuminated by dark cyan neon backlight

vo.text: Keep five thousand max in checking, sweep the rest to high yield.
vo.bgPrompt: Glowing cyan visual chart splitting capital into two distinct high-contrast pathways

vo.text: High yield pays four point five, checking pays practically zero.
vo.bgPrompt: Dark financial district tower glowing at night with subtle volumetric fog

vo.text: Banks profit four hundred twelve dollars on your default laziness.
vo.bgPrompt: Shadowy corporate boardroom table in high-contrast cinematic dark tone

vo.text: Which is why thirty-four dollars quietly disappears.
vo.bgPrompt: Dark minimalist glass office, stacks of cash on table lit by sharp spotlight
